page: Amazon Web Services g7e.2xlarge is a graphics and GPU-accelerated cloud instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8559C processor built on x86_64 architecture with 4 physical cores and 8 vCPUs running at a 2.4 GHz clock speed. System memory comprises 64.0 GB of DDR5 RAM operating at 6 GHz, supported by 320 MB of L3 cache. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single dedicated NVIDIA Blackwell RTX PRO 6000 GPU featuring 96 GB of VRAM. Dedicated local storage includes 1900 GB of NVMe SSD capacity, and networking capabilities feature a baseline bandwidth of 50 Gbps.

Benchmark results demonstrate top-tier execution in Geekbench single-core performance and text processing. Large language model inference tests show top-tier prompt processing and text generation speeds for 135M and 7B parameter models, along with strong performance in prompt processing for 70B models. Multi-core performance across stress-ng, Geekbench, and PassMark tests falls within the middle average range, consistent with the 8-vCPU allocation. Compression benchmarks indicate top-tier single-threaded gzip compression and strong single-threaded bzip3 decompression capabilities.

By combining a high-capacity 96 GB VRAM GPU, 1900 GB of fast local NVMe storage, and 64 GB of system RAM on an 8-vCPU footprint, the instance delivers effective resource density for GPU-bound tasks without requiring high vCPU scale. The hardware profile makes it suitable for artificial intelligence inference, computer vision pipelines, real-time graphics rendering, and storage-demanding machine learning applications.
description: Amazon Web Services g7e.2xlarge is an x86_64 GPU-accelerated cloud server featuring 8 vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8559C processor clocked at 2.4 GHz, 64.0 GB of DDR5 memory, and 320 MB of L3 cache. It incorporates a dedicated NVIDIA Blackwell RTX PRO 6000 GPU equipped with 96 GB of VRAM, 1900 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, and 50 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark evaluations highlight top-tier performance in single-core tasks, text processing, and LLM prompt processing and text generation for small and medium models. CPU multi-core operations and memory bandwidth perform in the average range. The server presents a cost-effective resource density for accelerated workloads by combining substantial GPU VRAM with fast local NVMe storage and high memory per vCPU. It is well-suited for machine learning inference, graphics processing, interactive text generation, and data-intensive AI pipelines.
